modules.name: Foundation (MVP)
modules.description: Schema parsing, validation, Pydantic/Freezed model generation, init/generate commands, Docker Compose

modules.name: API Layer
modules.description: FastAPI routes, Dart API client, SQLAlchemy ORM, migrations, serve/validate/migrate commands

modules.name: Real-time & Events
modules.description: Event publishing, SSE streams, WebSocket handlers, Temporal jobs, BLoC state generation

modules.name: Auth & Security
modules.description: JWT auth, OAuth providers, RBAC permissions, session management, MFA support

modules.name: Testing & Quality
modules.description: Factory generators, mock generators, contract tests, test/seed/lint commands

modules.name: Documentation & AI
modules.description: OpenAPI, Swagger UI, CLAUDE.md, MCP server, AI context, docs/ai commands

modules.name: DevOps & Release
modules.description: CI/CD pipelines, release management, deployment, app store metadata, i18n

technology_stack.cli: Python 3.11+ with Typer, Rich, Pydantic, Jinja2
technology_stack.frontend: Flutter with BLoC, Freezed, Dio, Drift

testing_approach: Integration tests first, unit tests second
notes: Each module builds upon the previous - must be completed sequentially
Module 00 (Foundation) is the MVP - generates working Pydantic and Freezed models
Integration tests validate against the FoodieAI example schema
All generated code must pass pyright (Python) and dart analyze (Dart)
